title: Edge count forcing a $K_4$-subdivision
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with $n \ge 4$ vertices and at least $2n - 2$ edges. Then $G$ contains a subdivision of $K_4$: four distinct branch vertices, joined in pairs by six paths that are internally disjoint from one another and whose interiors avoid all four branch vertices.
replaced:
\emph{ (B\&M \S{}8.3, verbatim).  }Show that if \texttt{G} is simple with
\texttt{$\nu$ $\ge$ 4} and \texttt{$\varepsilon$ $\ge$ 2$\nu$ - 2}, then \texttt{G} contains a subdivision of \texttt{K$_{4}$}.*
